# Load data

# I. Alpha diversity

## 1. Index calculation

```{r}
# 16S
AlphaDiv_16S <- estimate_richness(ps_rare_16S)

metadata_AlphaDiv_16S <- data.frame(AlphaDiv_16S, sample_data(ps_rare_16S), check.names=TRUE)
metadata_AlphaDiv_16S <- metadata_AlphaDiv_16S %>% 
  dplyr::rename(ObservedRichness = Observed)

df_AlphaDiv_16S <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(AlphaDiv_16S))

# ITS
AlphaDiv_ITS <- estimate_richness(ps_rare_ITS)

metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS <- data.frame(AlphaDiv_ITS, sample_data(ps_rare_ITS), check.names=TRUE)
metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS <- metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS %>% 
  dplyr::rename(ObservedRichness = Observed)

df_AlphaDiv_ITS <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(AlphaDiv_ITS))
```

## 2. Plots - 1 factor

### a. Function

```{r}
# BoxPlot 1 index + 1 group
plot_AlphaDiv_index <- function(df, group, group_labels, index, color_set) {
    df <- df |> 
    dplyr::filter((.data[[group]]) !="na") |> 
    dplyr::mutate(
      !!group := factor(.data[[group]], levels = group_labels))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[group]], y = .data[[index]], fill = .data[[group]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(1)) +
    geom_jitter(size = 1.5, shape = 21, position = position_jitter(0.1), alpha = 0.9, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_set, labels = group_labels) +
    labs(x = group, y = paste(index)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "Black", size = 14, angle = 90),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "Black", size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(color = "Black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "Black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "Black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "Black", size = 14),
      legend.position = "right")
  # +
  #   # 👇 Add significance stars + required a new parameter "method"
  #   stat_compare_means(comparisons = combn(group_labels, 2, simplify = FALSE), method = method,  label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 5)
}
```

### b. All samples

```{r}
sample_types <- c("G0_Adults_0days","Fruits_0days","G0_Adults_Fruits_2days","Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Larvae_Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Pupae_Nat_Inf_Fruit_5_6days", "G1_Adults_Nat_Inf_Fruit_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days")

## Bacterial Alpha div
# data
metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_SampleType <- filter(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S, SampleType !="na"& SampleType !="Medium_5_6days"& SampleType !="G1_Larvae_Medium_5_6days"& SampleType !="CT"& SampleType !="G0_Adults_Medium_2days"&SampleType !="")

df_AlphaDiv_16S_SampleType <- data.frame(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_SampleType)

# index calculation
Sha_SampleType_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(df_AlphaDiv_16S_SampleType, "SampleType",  sample_types, "Shannon" ,color_SampleType) 

ObsRich_SampleType_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(df_AlphaDiv_16S_SampleType, "SampleType",  sample_types, "ObservedRichness" ,color_SampleType)

Chao1_SampleType_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(df_AlphaDiv_16S_SampleType, "SampleType",  sample_types, "Chao1" ,color_SampleType)

invSimp_SampleType_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(df_AlphaDiv_16S_SampleType, "SampleType",  sample_types, "InvSimpson" ,color_SampleType)


## Fungal Alpha div
# data
metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_SampleType <- filter(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS, SampleType !="na"& SampleType !="Medium_5_6days"& SampleType !="G1_Larvae_Medium_5_6days"& SampleType !="CT"& SampleType !="G0_Adults_Medium_2days"&SampleType !="")

df_AlphaDiv_ITS_SampleType <- data.frame(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_SampleType)

# index calculation
Sha_SampleType_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(df_AlphaDiv_ITS_SampleType, "SampleType",  sample_types, "Shannon" ,color_SampleType) 

ObsRich_SampleType_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(df_AlphaDiv_ITS_SampleType, "SampleType",  sample_types, "ObservedRichness" ,color_SampleType)

Chao1_SampleType_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(df_AlphaDiv_ITS_SampleType, "SampleType",  sample_types, "Chao1" ,color_SampleType)

invSimp_SampleType_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(df_AlphaDiv_ITS_SampleType, "SampleType",  sample_types, "InvSimpson" ,color_SampleType)

## Figure : combine 16S and ITS plots
# Text labels
label_A <- wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob("A. BACTERIA", gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"), x = 0, hjust = 0))
label_B <- wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob("B. FUNGI", gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"), x = 0, hjust = 0))

# Suppress x-axis elements in row1
ST_16S <- (ObsRich_SampleType_16S + Chao1_SampleType_16S + Sha_SampleType_16S + invSimp_SampleType_16S) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect") & theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),axis.title.x = element_blank())

# row2 keeps x-axis text and title
ST_ITS <- (ObsRich_SampleType_ITS + Chao1_SampleType_ITS + Sha_SampleType_ITS + invSimp_SampleType_ITS) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect", axes = "collect_x", axis_titles = "collect_x") & theme( axis.text.x = element_text(color = "Black", size = 14, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

# Final plot
combined <- (label_A / ST_16S / label_B / ST_ITS) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(0.05, 1, 0.05, 1)) & theme(legend.position = "none")

title_plot <- "AlphaDiversity_SampleType_combined.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", title_plot),
                 combined, base_height = 21/cm(1),  base_width = 29.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

## 3. Plots - 2 factors

### a. Function

```{r}
# BoxPlot 1 index & 2 factors
plot_AlphaDiv_index_groups <- function(df, group, group_labels, index, color_set, facet_factor) {
  df <- df |> 
    dplyr::filter((.data[[group]]) !="na") |> 
    dplyr::filter((.data[[facet_factor]]) !="na") |>
    dplyr::mutate(!!group := factor(.data[[group]], levels = group_labels))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[group]], y = .data[[index]] , fill = .data[[group]]))+
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, position=position_dodge(1)) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(x=group, y = paste(index)) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(face=, color="Black", size=14, angle=0), legend.position = "right") +
      theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            axis.title.y = element_text(color="Black", size=14, face="bold"),
            legend.title = element_text(color = "Black", size = 14, face="bold"),
            legend.text = element_text(color = "Black", size = 14)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values =  color_set, labels = group_labels)+
      geom_jitter(size = 1.5, shape = 21, position = position_jitter(0.1), alpha = 0.9, color = "black") + ggh4x::facet_nested(as.formula(paste("~", group, "+", facet_factor)), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")

}
```

```{r}
## Figure : combine 16S and ITS plots
FTLS_16S <- (ObsRich_FTLS_16S + Chao1_FTLS_16S + Sha_FTLS_16S + invSimp_FTLS_16S) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect") & theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),axis.title.x = element_blank())

FTLS_ITS <- (ObsRich_FTLS_ITS + Chao1_FTLS_ITS + Sha_FTLS_ITS + invSimp_FTLS_ITS) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect", axes = "collect_x", axis_titles = "collect_x")

# Final plot
FTLS_combined <- (label_A / FTLS_16S / label_B / FTLS_ITS) +# Same text labels
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(0.05, 1, 0.05, 1)) & theme(legend.position = "none")

title_plot <- "AlphaDiv_FruitType+LifeStage_combined.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", title_plot),
                 FTvar_combined, base_height = 21/cm(1),  base_width = 29.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

# II. Beta diversity

## 1. Qualitative (Jaccard index)

### a. Fruits
```{r}
# Subset data
ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days"))

ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days"))
```

```{r}
##16S
ordi_nmds_J_16S_Fruits <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly, method ="NMDS", distance ="jaccard")

# NMDS with ellipses
NMDS_J_16S_Fruits_Ellipses <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(physeq = ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly, ordination = ordi_nmds_J_16S_Fruits) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = FruitVariety, shape = FruitType), size = 4) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(BL = 21, CH = 22, ST = 24)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_FruitVariety) + 
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = FruitVariety, color = FruitVariety), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = color_FruitVariety) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Fruit Variety", ncol = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Fruit Type"),
    color = "none")

# reorder life stages
NMDS_J_16S_Fruits_Ellipses$data$FruitVariety <- factor(NMDS_J_16S_Fruits_Ellipses$data$FruitVariety, levels = c("CDP", "HED", "STA", "SUM" , "SWE" , "CIF", "CIR", "DRE", "INF", "MDB", "LOC", "UNK")) 

title_plot <- "NMDS_16S_FruitType_FruitVariety.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", title_plot),
                 NMDS_J_16S_Fruits_Ellipses, base_height = 20/cm(1),
                base_width = 20/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

 
## ITS

# plot with ellipses
NMDS_J_ITS_Fruits_Ellipses <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(physeq = ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly, ordination = ordi_nmds_J_ITS_Fruits) + 
  theme_bw() +

  scale_shape_manual(values = c(BL = 21, CH = 22, ST = 24)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_FruitVariety) + 
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = FruitVariety, color = FruitVariety), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = color_FruitVariety) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Fruit Variety", ncol = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Fruit Type"),
    color = "none")

# reorder life stages
NMDS_J_ITS_Fruits_Ellipses$data$FruitVariety <- factor(NMDS_J_ITS_Fruits_Ellipses$data$FruitVariety, levels = c("CDP", "HED", "STA", "SUM" , "SWE" , "CIF", "CIR", "DRE", "INF", "MDB", "LOC", "UNK"))

 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_diversities", title_plot),
```

```{r}
# Filter data
ps_16S_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")

ps_16S_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_16S_rare_expe, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

ordi_nmds_J_16S_expe <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_16S_rare_expe, method ="NMDS", distance ="jaccard") # stress = 0.1554185

# rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Aunts = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

# plot with ellipses

  theme_bw() +

  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = SampleType, color = SampleType), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = color_Expe) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Sample Type", ncol = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Fruit Type"), 
    #size = guide_legend(title = "Population"),
    color = "none")
```
